self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 A Cast Real Far: triggering a Cryo- or Hydro-related Elemental Reaction grants +40% ATK for 15s (16s ICD). The 12 Elemental Energy it restores to the rest of the party is not modelled.

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1).

en.flavor: A spear of solid ice imbued with an icy chill. It is said that it once belonged to the Belyi Tsar who ruled Snezhnaya in the distant past.

refinements.1: Triggering a Cryo or Hydro-related elemental reaction increases the equipping character's ATK by <r>20%</r> for the next 15s, as well as regenerates <r>6</r> Elemental Energy for other members of their party. This effect can trigger once every 16s.
refinements.2: Triggering a Cryo or Hydro-related elemental reaction increases the equipping character's ATK by <r>25%</r> for the next 15s, as well as regenerates <r>7.5</r> Elemental Energy for other members of their party. This effect can trigger once every 16s.
refinements.3: Triggering a Cryo or Hydro-related elemental reaction increases the equipping character's ATK by <r>30%</r> for the next 15s, as well as regenerates <r>9</r> Elemental Energy for other members of their party. This effect can trigger once every 16s.
refinements.4: Triggering a Cryo or Hydro-related elemental reaction increases the equipping character's ATK by <r>35%</r> for the next 15s, as well as regenerates <r>10.5</r> Elemental Energy for other members of their party. This effect can trigger once every 16s.
refinements.5: Triggering a Cryo or Hydro-related elemental reaction increases the equipping character's ATK by <r>40%</r> for the next 15s, as well as regenerates <r>12</r> Elemental Energy for other members of their party. This effect can trigger once every 16s.

fr.flavor: Une lance de glace pure imprégnée d'un froid glacial. On raconte qu'elle appartenait jadis au Tsar Belyi, qui régna sur Snezhnaya dans un lointain passé.

refinements.1: Pendant 15 s après avoir déclenché une réaction élémentaire liée à l'élément Cryo ou à l'élément Hydro, l'ATQ du personnage équipé de l'arme augmente de <r>20 %</r> et les autres personnages de votre équipe récupèrent <r>6</r> pts d'énergie élémentaire.
